ticker_news.title: Why Advanced Micro Devices Stock Plummeted 15.4% Last Month and Has Inched Lower in March
ticker_news.description: AMD stock fell 15.4% in February despite posting strong Q4 earnings and revenue beats, as investors expected even stronger forward guidance amid AI demand. The company announced a significant partnership expansion with Meta for AI GPUs and CPUs. AMD's decline was part of a broader tech sector pullback driven by AI valuation concerns and macroeconomic headwinds, though the company's fundamentals remain solid.
ticker_news.author: Keith Noonan

ticker_news.title: Marvell Gets a Fresh Bid as AI Infrastructure Spending Lifts Revenue Visibility
ticker_news.description: Marvell Technology reported strong Q4 FY2026 earnings with $2.22B revenue (22% YoY growth) and issued bullish forward guidance, raising FY2027 revenue outlook to over 30% growth nearing $11B and FY2028 to nearly 40% growth approaching $15B. The semiconductor company is benefiting from massive AI infrastructure spending by Big Tech giants, with record design wins and bookings driving confidence in future growth.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Fries

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500 Futures Tumble As Payrolls Edge Down 92K— Marvell Technology, Gap, Oracle In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures fell on Friday amid ongoing Iran-US conflict and ahead of February employment data. Markets expect 55,000 payroll additions and a steady 4.3% jobless rate. The Fed is expected to hold rates unchanged in March with 97.3% probability. Key movers include Marvell Technology surging 11.92% on strong earnings, Gap tumbling 7.06% on disappointing results, and Oracle rising on AI-driven job cut plans.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
